## Key publications

See @tbl-mws-pubs.

```{r}
#| label: tbl-mws-pubs
#| tbl-cap: "Representative Million Women Study publications across outcomes."
library(reactable)

# Pipe-delimited so each paper is one line (avoids column misalignment).
pubs <- read.delim(text =
"Year|Authors|Theme|Topic|Journal|DOI
1999|Million Women Study Collab. Group|Cohort/methods|Study design & population characteristics|Breast Cancer Res|10.1186/bcr16
2003|Beral (MWS Collaborators)|Cancer—breast|HRT & breast cancer risk|Lancet|10.1016/s0140-6736(03)14065-2
2013|Pirie et al.|Other chronic disease|21st-century hazards of smoking, benefits of stopping|Lancet|10.1016/S0140-6736(12)61720-6
2020|Kim et al.|Other chronic disease|Alcohol intake & Parkinson's disease risk|Mov Disord|10.1002/mds.27933
2021|Floud et al.|Other chronic disease|Cognitive/social activities & dementia risk|Lancet Public Health|10.1016/S2468-2667(20)30284-X",
  sep = "|", header = TRUE, quote = "", strip.white = TRUE,
  check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, encoding = "UTF-8"
)

reactable(pubs, filterable = TRUE, sortable = TRUE)
```
